protocol.metric_policy: expected overhead = mean extra symbols to decode per cell, with dead cells contributing the cap value 4; secondary: fail@+0 and fail@+2 fractions, dead@cap fraction, hard-K fraction (share of sampled K where every construction seed fails at +2), per-cell [K, extra] list, WH1 construct-failure count
protocol.plot_axes: y = expected overhead (mean extra symbols, dead cells contribute 4), x = encoder throughput; untuned architectures only
protocol.timing_seed_policy: production seed derivation (tuning knobs applied); the untuned fixed construction seed governs only the overhead statistics
protocol.wh1_measurement: exact first-success extra via incremental matrix-only DecodeFeed, censored at +4 absolute extras
protocol.wh1_work_proxy: gf256 byte counters (add/add2/addset vs mul/muladd) around encoder init + first K symbols at bb=1 from a WH_COUNT build; bytes at bb=1 approximate operation counts
protocol.wh2_measurement: dense overhead levels 0..4 with ascending early stop (exact within the cap); censored at +4
